scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MK Lomror b MG Bracewell

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b MG Bracewell

batting.name: GD Phillips
batting.dismissal: c WD Parnell b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c GD Phillips b B Kumar

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c RA Tripathi b T Natarajan

balls.text: Pulled in the air, Parnell settles under it and takes an easy low catch at deep backward square. Phillips reviews just as a formality to check if it was the second bouncer over the shoulder for the over. Replay shows it was at rib-height. Fair ball, Siraj ends with figures of 1 for 17.
Underarms a throw from a few metres away. Maxwell smiles in disbelief. It was a length ball that Phillips tried to hoick across the line. It went to the edge of the pitch on the off side

Makes room, misses the cut, Phillips runs in for a bye. No direct hit at the striker's end by the keeper, who threw it on the bounce. It was a shortish ball that Brook tried to lift. Phillips had his toe in the crease at the non-striker's end and ready to take off
Wide and full, Brook tries to scythe it square and misses
Bouncer, Brook makes room and it goes well over his head. It was over middle and is left alone
Pulls the hard-length ball from just over the stumps. Limited timing takes the 138kph ball to the right of long-on
Charges and cover drives the low full toss on the move to the fielder at the edge of the circle
Slow low full toss is lifted over the bowler, too straight for long-on to cut off. Phillips starts at top gear again

Dipping yorker beats Klaasen's swing, hits the base of middle. Harshal turns back and applauds. Brilliant innings. He leaves to a rousing reception from the crowd and team-mates alike. Slower one, Klaasen tried to make room as he tried to swipe it across
Short ball over head height, Brook tried the upper cut and missed it. Keeper half-stopped it
Makes room and pulls the shortish ball to dee square leg

Pumped down town and Klaasen is jubilant in celebration. Off just 49 balls, he'e now SRH's second-fastest centurion. He charged and got to the pitch, launched it high and far. Straight six. His body was thundering and he was glistening in sweat as he removed his helmet and pumped his fists with a bat in hand and helmet in the other.
He stays at a normal position, gets a slow dipping low-fully around fourth stump. Crouches and hits it off the bottom of the bat to long-off
Yorker on middle, flicked to long leg. Pace: 119kph.
Nails a yorker to complete a great over. Klaasen stood leg side and all he could do was jam it from just outside off to cover
Length outside off, slapped to Shahbaz at backward point. Fumble takes the ball to the right, costs him a single

Makes room and gets a full toss on middle. Extra cover drive lands around the edge of the circle and maintains pace as it goes towards the boundary, Maxwell runs quickly to the left and dives to keep it to two
Flicks the length ball at 134kph from middle stump to long-on
Opens the face of the bat to guide the length ball outside off to short third
Flicks the length ball to deep square leg to go to 94*

Goes on one knee and tries to slog sweep the fullish ball angling down leg. Ball goes off the top of the bat and fine. Along the ground for four more. 48 runs in the last three overs, as Vairavan notes here.
Stays still with that high backlift, slaps the length ball to deep cover
Makes room early and Shahbaz goes at sixth stump at 93kph, slapped into the outfield, on the way to long-off
Stays leg side and slaps the length ball just outside off to deep backward point. Fifty stand up
This time Klaasen doesn't have to make room, gets a half-volley for an easy step-hit for an 85-metre six. Back over the bowler again
Makes room and pumps the overpitched ball following him, towards the sightscreen. Klaasen's bat was hanging back like it was a baseball bat, hit 83 metres far
Yorker-length ball at the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket along the ground
Wide and full, gets on one knee and slaps the 118kph ball to long-off
Full ball hit to long-on
Helped away wide of short fine. Low-ish full toss around off, Klaasen had to crouch and roll the wrist as he closed the bat face, managed to do it and get it along the ground
Very full again, drilled to long-on
Dipping low full toss goes under Brook's attempted cover drive. Batter's bottom hand came off as well
Pulls the length ball from just outside leg to the left of deep square, Shahbaz sends a good throw. Anuj flicks it on target without looking at the stumps but Klaasen was too quick
Back of length ball is flicked to midwicket
Overpitched and too wide, Klaasen waits and goes on one knee, slaps it over cover for a flat six
Full ball at 88kph is flicked to long-on
Brook clears his back leg and lifts the full ball at the stumps over long-off for an 88-metre six. It was just an extended drive
Length ball is given some air and Brook goes deep in his crease and pulls it in the gap at midwicket

Klaasen makes it eight despite Kohli's scamper to the right from deep-midwicket. Ball was on a back of length just outside off, pulled flat in the air, into the outfield. Kohli tried to palm it on the move but it was too fast for him.
Block hole on off, tails in and is blocked to cover
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third
In-between length curves in to middle and off, flicked to Kohli's left at it's stopped with a dive
Length on off, flicked along the ground past the diving Kohli at catching midwicket, to the right of wide long-on for an easy two
Back of length over off, defended behind point
Full on off, thick outside edge off the straight blade takes it to cover

Markram misses the reverse and Shahbaz hits the off pole. He's chuffed with his comeback. Length ball around off straightened a bit, Markram tried to rise with the ball and lifted his back leg as he lost balance. He noticed the ball was too close and tried to close the gap between his wrists and his torso but missed it completely and the stump was rattled.
Blocks the length ball to the bowler
Length at the stumps. The 98kph ball is flicked to deep midwicket
Flicks it off a back of length to long leg.
Chopped back to the bowler, who tries to deflect it back on the stumps but the ball sticks in the palms for a second and Markram makes it back
Overpitched around fourth stump, driven to long-off
Yorker on middle at 138kph, drilled out with a flick to long-on
Pitched up on middle and off, punched to the left of Parnell's outstretched hand in follow-through. Goes to long-off
Whips the length ball at 135kph on middle stump to long-on, along the ground
Tucks the length ball from the thigh pad to deep fine leg
Pulls the back-of-length ball just outside off to wide long-on, Virat runs from deep-mid and sends a one-bounce throw to Parnell. Bails flicked but the batter is safe
Klaasen slaps the wide length ball to deep-backward point to get to fifty
Tossed up on off, slapped to deep extra cover
Fullish ball is pushed to long-on
Tossed up invitingly but it's too wide outside off to make him fetch
Overpitched at the stumps, it's slow and Klaasen stays leg side and pumps it over the ground for an 85-metre six
Cuts the length ball to deep-backward point. Misfield allows two
Stays put and punches the length ball on off to cover
Length around fifth stump, punched to cover
Very full at the stumps, flicked from middle stump to deep-backward square
Shortish ball around sixth stump, cut to deep point. Pace: 135kph
Slower yorker, Markram's bat lifts a bit high, comes down from the second-slip area as it jams the ball to the bowler's right
Wide of the crease again. Length ball at 129kph comes in to middle, flicked to wide long-on. Brings up the fifty stand
In-between length on leg at 131kph, clipped to the right of long-on
Full ball at 93kph is flicked from middle stump to deep midwicket. Kohli charges in, so two isn't on
Given some air but it's wide and Klaasen can't middle the cut. Goes off the underedge into the grass, to point
Flicks the length ball at 91kph to long-on
Backs away and cuts it with limited timing. To long-off

Not that short, spins away but Klaasen still nails the pull. It was on a length, landed around leg and went to middle and off. Klaasen cleared the front leg and powered it across the line for a 74-metre six.
Legbreak lands outside leg and spins away, still outside leg; flicked off the back foot to long-on
Flicks the length ball to midwicket
Nudged to midwicket, Virat charges from the deep. Throws the ball from in the circle to Bracewell at the non-striker's end. But Klaasen was well in, not sent upstairs.
Klaasen gets a quick single even though it was off a leading edge. Back of length just outside off, tried to clip it away. Went off the outer-half of the bat to cover
Shortish ball from wide of the crease is pulled through wide mid-on. It was on a back of length at 130kph just outside off, short-arm jab came with a still base and perfect contact
Punches the length ball from the channel to mid-off
Flicks the length ball to deep midwicket

Pulled with the spin from off stump, gets it flat along square leg. It's not too short but he's standing still and anticipating on the back foot, did well to hit the gap at square leg and not get it towards midwicket, as Simon Katich notes on air.
Length ball at the stumps is clipped to the leg side
Shovels the length ball with the spin to short fine

Goes for the reverse and might have been hit on the helmet. Replay shows it went off the edge back into his jaw, just under the chin. Klaasen turned his neck quickly to the off side and the length ball got him. Gets some medical attention and he's okay
Punches the length ball spinning in to middle and off at 95kph back to the bowler
Full ball is flicked to long-on
Punches to extra cover, Maxwell fumbles trying to stop a four. It allows the batter to take two. It was a length ball that was hit off the back foot
Shahbaz tries to go a tad fuller, still on a length, but Klaasen goes on one knee and tries to sweep it hard. Gets it off the inside edge, ball rolls quickly in the gap to the left of short fine leg
Rocks back and pulls the length ball from middle stump, clears the front leg and hits it over wide long-on almost. Deep midwicket was straight but it went well to his right
Full ball is driven to long-off
Full ball is pushed to long-on
Slightly wide, the length ball sits up and Klaasen is deep in his crease, waiting on the back foot. Cuts it in the gap through cover
Length on middle, flicked to mid-on
Backs away again and cuts it off the stumps to cover again. Pace down to 91kph
Quicker 101kph ball is cut from off stump to the cover boundary. He went on the back foot and backed away as he hit it past the diving fielder.

Another softy, this time Tripathi slog-paddles it from outside off and finds short fine leg. He went across early and Bracewell went into the pitch. Tripathi tried going through with the shot but it ballooned and dipped again after going off the bat for a low catch.
Length ball turns in to off, flicked to mid-on's right

Loosener is slapped straight to Lomror at cover point. It was short and wide at 92kph, Abhishek went back and tried to cut it hard. The ball looped off the bat without gaining elevation, Lomror went on one knee and took a low catch. A dejected Abhishek walks back.
Mistimes another whip off a similar-length ball on the hips, this time it goes into the ground behind. Short fine leg stops it

Flogged away off the inside edge, it still goes over the infield. Siraj runs back from midwicket but ball won the race. It was on a back of length and Abhishek tried to flick it, the ball hit low on the bat, which made it turn in the hand
Length on off, defended to cover and they go off for a quick run. No direct hit again from the fast throw, this time at the striker's end
Tripathi is waiting for the shortish ball, gets the slower one around waist-height and hits it 74 metres far from within the crease. Just clears the ropes.
Takes a step across before making room and slapping the length ball over short third
Length on off at 141kph, defended to point
Back of length on the hips, clipped to midwicket

Run out chance, Shahbaz tries to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end and misses. Tripathi was nowhere in the picture and no fielder was backing up. It was a back-of-length ball that pitched outside leg and angled away, it beat the flick off the back foot and deflected off the pad. Tripathi took off but Abhishek did not respond, the throw went as Tripathi turned and gave up. Went to Shahbaz on a decent bounce too. An early miss for RCB.
Siraj sends Abhishek on the back foot with a bumper over off stump. Abhishek takes his head away from the line and lets it go
Pitched up just outside off, Abhishek stands still and lays into the cover drive. Lands deep in the outfield and goes over the cushions

Lands on a similar length but shapes away, Abhishek follows it and RCB appeal for a caught behind. Not given and the decision has been reviewed. Wobble-seam ball had Abhishek try to punch it off the back foot, he tried to go square which created an angled bat. The ball, hence, missed the outside edge and RCB lose a review.
Back of length on fourth stump at 139kph, defended back to the bowler off the back foot
Tripathi uses the width and creams a square drive, deep-backward point had no chance as it sped to the gap to his right. It was around a length at 129kph, easy picking.
Tripathi premeditates, goes across and tries to scoop the length ball. Misses and the ball goes just over off stump.

Tripathi goes for a delicate flick off the back foot and misses, the ball deflects off the body to the pitch in front. It was banged in on a back of length and the batter tried to pat it with a horizontal bat towards square leg.
Length on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket. Abhishek's bat turned upon impact but the bat went right into the ground
Length at the stumps, blocked to the bowler
Flat bats it and mid-on does well, the skipper there leaps to right and stops it. The ball was shortish outside off, Abhishek eased into the slap.

Pitched up and Tripathi drives. He aims towards cover but the ball goes off the inside edge to the left of mid-on. Fielder charges in as the non-striker returns to his crease. RCB's fielders have looked proactive so far.
Back of length just outside off, punched with an open bat face to point
Length on leg at 137kph, clipped to square leg. Bracewell runs in and underarms the ball as Tripathi runs back
Underedge takes the ball into the ground behind and then the keeper. On a back of length outside off, Tripathi tried to dab it off the back foot to deep third
In-between length on middle and off at 140kph, driven to the right of mid-off
Pitched up at the stumps, blocked back to the bowler
Inswing takes the length ball starting on leg stump down leg, past the flick and to the keeper's thumb before popping to the right
Full ball is driven, mid-off half-stops it but it deflects into the outfield. Easy two and Klaasen looks up into the heavens as RCB win by eight wickets.
Length ball down leg goes past the flick. Extra run scored though
Driven, mid-off is in. Goes straight towards him, Maxwell tries to take off and runs back as the fielder runs in
Reverse laps it fine and in the gap. Took a step past the crease and redirected the ball with full control. Too fine for short third to stop.
Low full toss is driven into the ground. Bowler ducked and tried to take it over the right shoulder but it went too fast
Full and slow on middle. Opens the face to guide the 123kph ball to deep-backward point
Back of length ball is pulled from middle and off to deep midwicket

Slow and full, Faf tries to launch it away but holes out at long-off. He screamed in agony right after hitting it. Swiped across and saucered it high. Tripathi falls back on the ground with the ball nestled in front of his chest.
Wide full toss is flapped over cover. Into the outfield, easy four
Goes across and tries to paddle the full ball, angles down leg to beat the bat and leg stump
Maxwell tries the reverse scoop first ball. The length ball on fourth stump may have deflected off the pad, seemed to have deflected inwards after passing the stumps

Hundred and out, Kohli's skied a pull and it's taken by Phillips at deep forward square. It was head-high bouncer that Kohli tried to launch in front of square. Phillips was well within the cushion. Kohli walks back with a smile into the dugout

Whipped away over deep midwicket. Hundo for Kohli, who gets a bear hug from Faf, he raises his bat and goes on his knees. Crowd's roaring. Absolute scenes. It was very full and Kohli flicked it flat, hard, and long enough. Fielder was running back to the diagonal left but it sailed over
Kohli walks down Matthew Hayden style and misses the pull. Smart from Bhuvi to go short and outside off at 132kph, it doesn't rise much

Risky second is run so quick that they make it without much trouble given there was no direct hit. Faf's heaving the breaths in. It was a yorker at the stumps that was jammed to mid-on. Long-on came in, looked like Brook, and it would have been out had there been a direct hit.
Very full outside off at 131kph, pushed to cover
Low full toss at 135kph is pushed from off stump to cover. Went off the toe of the bat
Another yorker. On leg and it's squeezed to deep fine leg
Yorker has Faf tumble. He made room and was followed, tried to whip it away. Missed it, may have hit the ground and the ball went to the keeper
Length outside off, driven to deep cover
Skiddy bouncer is pulled over midwicket. Kohli held onto a strong base and smoked it 77 metres far
Works the back-of-length ball to deep square leg
Length outside off, driven to point. They've played out Dagar's over for just four runs. Didn't take risks there.
Length outside off, cut to the left of cover point
Turns away again. Faf tried to cut it but the length ball pitched on fourth stump and took the bottom-quarter of the bat. Luckily for Faf, the bat face was looking at the ground
Length ball outside off sits up for the cut, hit hard and along the ground straight to deep cover
Length ball spins away to fourth stump, cut to deep cover
Overpitched on leg, stays leg side and drives the 92kph ball to long-off
Length outside off, creamed to long-on. RCB's 150 is up

Misfield from Phillips running in to the right, got to the ball at the deep-point area. He went low and tried to close his palms and collect the ball but it deflected back onto the cushion. That was a shortish wide ball that was cut through point, spun to the left
Low full toss is lifted from outside off back over the bowler with one hand off the bat. Long-on ran to the left but it went too straight
Length outside off, hit to cover
Good lord, that's a lofted extra cover with chocolate chips and sprinkles on top. In-between length outside off, Kohli just chipped it over the fielder and held his shape. That'll make the galleries
Thumps the back-of-length ball outside off through cover, sizzles the grass and the man in the deep has no chance
Around a length outside off. past the tramline. Let go
Half-tracker is pulled almost into the second tier. Kohli's punching his fists as he walks towards his partner. That sat up and Faf was deep in his crease.
Length on middle and leg, pulled to long-on
Wide low full toss is let go, the keeper half-stopped it.
Clips the length ball towards midwicket
Sits up on a length outside off, Faf stays still and spanks it through extra
Makes room and opens the face to guide the length ball from middle stump to short third
Length on off, blocked to cover.

Great stop at deep midwicket, saves three potential runs. He went to the left and palmed the ball from the front of face to his left. It was a short ball that was pulled into the outfield. Went flat and on the bounce
Cuts a length ball outside off to deep point
No-look slog sweep is crunched over midwicket! It was overpitched at the stumps, slow as well. Kohli went on one knee and thumped it with a rare sweep.
Yorker on off, driven to cover
Length ball on leg, Kohli backs away and cuts to cover
Delicate dab is stopped by short third. Length ball spun in to fourth stump, Kohli waited and tapped it on the head. Fielder went to the left
Pulls the shortish ball to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, cut to point
Pulls the shortish ball with the spin to get to fifty. Kohli raises his bat and turns around, crowd's noisy again. The ball came in towards his waist. Hit it over square leg for a one-bounce four
Length ball spins to leg, flicked to deep square leg

Full on fourth stump at 92kph, nudges it towards midwicket. Deep fielder has to run till just outside the yard and Faf scoots for the second. Gets to his fifty, hundred stand up too. He raises his bat and gets a good round of applause
Down the track again. Abhishek goes full and wide at 91kph. Faf reaches out and swipes it to get it to long-off
Dances down and opens the face of the bat to push to length ball to point
Tries to whip the full ball but gets it off the edge. Goes towards long-on
Length ball outside off. Kohli tries to slap it towards cover but gets it into the pitch in front
Length on fourth stump, chopped to backward point
Makes room and slaps the full ball, along the carpet, to long-off. Both bats on 47* off 31.
Slaps the length ball after making room to long-off. Misfielded but it goes a few metres behind, to his diagonal right
Fullish ball is blocked off the outer-half of the straight bat towards point

Quick running allows two. It was a full ball nurdled to midwicket, Phillips charged from deep-mid, deep square and bowler were chasing too. Throw is flat to the left of the keeper, who can't collect the ball but dislodges the bail with his hands
Length ball spins away after landing around leg. Opens the face and defends to the left of cover point
Overpitched on leg, flicked to midwicket
Goes back to the shortish ball and works it across to midwicket
Slaps the shortish ball outside off to cover
Full ball, mistimes the slog to deep midwicket

Looks like a screamer by Dagar running at deep midwicket. RCB review to check if it was the second bouncer over shoulder-height. It's a marginal call, Faf's back leg isn't bent much and the ball is hit from in front of his nose. A few replays later, the third umpire rules it in favour of Faf. Dagar ran to the right and took a low catch while diving.
Length ball jags in and rises, Faf tries to help it across but is done by the movement. Gets the heave off the inside edge to the flank
Taps the length ball to point and takes off. Throw at the non-striker's end misses, Brook backs up
Bouncer. Kohli charges and pulls it from head height, goes off the sticker in the gap to the left of short fine

Kohli swats a flick a 103 metres far and Faf goes oooo. It was a length ball on top of the pad, Kohli stood absolutely still and mixed a short-arm jab with a traditional on-drive and finished with a strong, whippy followthrough
Tries it again, belts the cut with better timing but gets it straight to cover
Makes room and slashes, goes off the outside edge over short third. It was on a length at the stumps, Faf was well down leg and hit it as hard as he could
Shooter straightens off a length, Faf tried to defend with a straight bat. Got it off the outside edge towards short third
Cuts a shortish length ball that sits up on middle to deep point
Length ball grips in the pitch and Faf adjusts as he goes deep in the crease. Clipped to deep square leg
Stays leg side and punches the length ball from middle and leg to long-on. Pace: 92kph
Hard length just outside off, windscreen-wiper flick takes it to deep midwicket
Slow ball on a fullish length on fifth stump, bunted with an open face to deep point
Steps out and pulls the short ball that rises only to belly height. Not perfectly timed. Goes to deep midwicket
Helped away behind square. Slower one into the pitch, whips it from thigh-height. Gets it through the gap at deep-backward square
Minimal foot movement from Kohli as he takes a small step to the right and punches the length ball to cover
Length at the stumps, flicked to square leg

Run-out chance missed, Faf dove into the ground and slid his bat in but he didn't look to be in the frame. Makes room to a back of length ball and tries to cut it, goes off the bottom of the bat to cover. Rahul Tripathi got to it quick and threw it quick, had one stump to aim at. Ball sped past but missed the target.
Length outside off, driven to cover
Into the pitch at 122kph, doesn't rise much. Clipped off the knee to midwicket
Bouncer just over the head is at stump-line. Left alone
Bat face closes as he whips the full ball back from the crease, gets it to deep forward square
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward square
Crunches a punch off the front foot to get the length ball outside off to cover
Slow on a length in the channel, opens the face and slaps it to deep point
Back of length over middle, pulled to the left of deep square. Stopped with a dive
Around a yorker length just outside off, slammed into the ground. The wobble ball goes fast into the pitch off the bat, through the straight-mid-on area
In the air, deep square leg backtracks and sticks out a hand. It goes over him!
Shortish ball is wide, cut to deep-backward point
Wide on a back of length, cut to deep point
Driven on the up through extra. Races along the ground wide of mid-off. It was on a length in the channel.
Wide, low full toss. Faf jams it to backward point. Quick single, Faf slides his bat past the crease and tackles the umpire but he was decelerating
Short and wide again, Faf slaps it from shoulder height. Not middled but gets it over mid-off

Top edge off the pull, Phillips is trodding to his left at deep midwicket... and shells it!. It was a short ball that was pulled from just outside off, it was high and going away to the left of deep square leg, where Phillips was standing. He got there, the ball came to his left, so he had to reach out with his hands and it didn't stick.
Slaps the short, wide ball. Doesn't middle it, up and under over point. Two bounces, four.
Length ball comes back in and beats the flick, hits the thigh pad and falls in front
Pitched up on middle, Faf stays leg side and whips it to deep square leg. Bat turned in the hand and it went along the ground
In-between length on off at 135kph, driven to cover
Full ball is pushed to mid-off for a quick single

French cut just misses off stump, races to the left of the diving keeper. Four. Length ball on fifth stump, Kohli tries to slap it away but his left leg opened up. He tried to go across the line with a swipe which almost cost him
Length just outside off, defended to cover
Overpitched on leg, tossed up and Faf directs it to long-on
Yorker on the pads, flicked to deep square
Kohli makes room and gets a length ball at the stumps, pummels it with a horizontal bat. Over the head and to the left of the bowler, fourth four in nine balls for Kohli
Full ball is blocked in front
Abhishek goes wide down leg anticipating Kohli to make room again but the batter stood still and let it go
Makes room, gets a full ball following him that he lofts back over the bowler. Hit into the outfield, too straight for any fielder
Length around off at 88kph, whipped to deep square leg
Shorter ball is slightly wider, tries to flat-bat it but gets it off the bottom again. To mid-off again
Length ball just over fifth stump, Kohli stands tall and punches it again. Limited timing, goes to mid-off
Bhuvi throws the bait again but Kohli lets go of the length ball outside off
Back of length outside off, Kohli tries to punch it with the horizontal bat. Goes off the inside edge towards mid-on
Slightly shorter than the previous ball, Kohli goes on the back foot and carves it over point
Square driven with the outswing. Length ball landed around fourth stump and curved away, Kohli reached out a bit and creamed it in the gap in front of point
